correctness.rationale: For each coefficient ring, the endomorphism relations are precisely the independent Frobenius coefficient equations. The determinant criterion follows from residue-field Nakayama plus finite-free determinant lifting, even over nonreduced rings. Eliminating nilpotent linear variables block-triangularizes the cotangent matrix and yields the exact open coordinate ring and scheme decomposition. Dimensions, locally free rank and finite-field point count are direct consequences. Independent exhaustive multiplication-and-full-matrix tests passed for five small prime-field configurations; those experiments are supporting checks, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result provides complete nonreduced group-scheme coordinates for every rank and exponent pattern in a natural family of Frobenius monomial complete intersections, derives arbitrarily large differences between reduced variety dimension and Lie dimension, gives exact infinitesimal thickening rank, and counts rational automorphisms over all finite fields. This distinguishes characteristic-p deformation behavior from characteristic-zero automorphism descriptions and is more than a routine isolated example.
